Text: The standard Math class methods do not check for overflow, but Java 8 introduced {{c1::Math.addExact()}} to throw an exception on overflow.
Extra: Exact math operations prevent silent numeric wrapping bugs.

Text: To avoid thread contention when generating random numbers in concurrent applications, use {{c1::ThreadLocalRandom.current()::ThreadLocalRandom}}.
Extra: It keeps a separate seed per thread to avoid CAS loop overhead.

Text: For security-sensitive operations such as password generation, use {{c1::SecureRandom}} instead of java.util.Random.
Extra: SecureRandom uses cryptographically strong CSPRNG algorithms.

Text: java.util.Random is built on the {{c1::Linear Congruential Generator::LCG}} algorithm, which is predictable and not cryptographically secure.
Extra: LCG is mathematically simple and deterministic if the seed is known.

Text: In BigDecimal, the internal value is represented by an unscaledValue and a {{c1::scale}}, which is a 32-bit integer representing the power of ten.
Extra: Scale controls the decimal point placement.

Text: A BigDecimal value is mathematically calculated as {{c1::unscaledValue * 10^-scale}}.
Using the constructor {{c1::new BigDecimal(0.1)}} is a common mistake because double literals introduce binary representation noise.
To safely initialize a BigDecimal with a decimal value, use the constructor taking a {{c1::String}} or the static method valueOf().
Extra: Using String or valueOf() ensures the exact decimal value is represented.

Text: The class java.lang.Runtime is implemented using the {{c1::Singleton}} design pattern, and its instance is accessed via getRuntime().
Extra: Only one Runtime instance represents the JVM.

Text: The method {{c1::System.exit()}} is a convenience wrapper that delegates directly to Runtime.getRuntime().exit().
Extra: It provides static access to JVM shutdown.

Text: Spawning an external process without consuming its stdout or stderr stream can cause the process to {{c1::hang::block indefinitely}} because the OS buffer fills up.
Extra: Use inheritIO() or read from process.getInputStream().

Text: Direct Map manipulation on java.util.Properties is a violation of the {{c1::Liskov Substitution Principle::LSP}}.
Extra: Properties inherits Hashtable<Object,Object> instead of composing it.

Text: Calling store() on a Properties object containing a non-String value throws a runtime {{c1::ClassCastException}}.
Extra: The serialization logic expects only String keys and values.

Text: The nextLine() pitfall in Scanner occurs because token-based methods like nextInt() do not consume the trailing {{c1::newline character::\n}}.
Extra: The subsequent nextLine() immediately consumes the leftover \n.

Text: If a base resource bundle properties file is missing from the classpath, the JVM throws a runtime {{c1::MissingResourceException}}.
Extra: Always provide a fallback base translation file.

Text: Creating a locale using new Locale("en_US") is a bug because the constructor expects the language and country as {{c1::separate arguments}}.
Extra: Use Locale.forLanguageTag("en-US") or separate constructor arguments.
